v11.2.0:
- Flow equalization rate (EqualizeK) is now a Mod Setting, allowing you to set how fast or slow the water 'moves'. This mod now requires Mod Settings.
- New Outflow UI: Outfall pipe and Throttle Valve Pipe show how much water left it.
- Added Throttle Valve Pipe. See mod description and in-game description for more information.
- Some simulation optimization.
Bug fixes:
- Valve Extract/Fill in does not work when a building is built after a Valve.
- Outfall pipes are now properly stopped by Automation.

- Added Impermeable Vertical Cross.
- Increased Science cost for Outfall Pipe to 350.
Visual only:
- Valve model updated when facing in/out of a supported building.
